lines.zh: 我拍着小翅膀跟在你后面。
lines.en: I flap my little wings along behind you.
I land and bounce straight up again.
I hop around your feet.
This tiny body of mine is very light.

lines.zh: 我踩在你的影子里往前。
lines.en: I move forward inside your shadow.
I fly a stretch, then land a stretch.
My tail feathers bob up and down.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的转向一起转。
lines.en: I turn when you turn.
I drop to the ground and catch up again.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边很小。
lines.en: My shadow is very small at your feet.
I hop forward on one foot.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着半格的距离。
lines.en: Half a block of air lies between us.

lines.zh: 我停在你肩上，理着羽毛。
lines.en: I perch on your shoulder and preen.
I hop twice on your shoulder.
Dust falls from my feathers.
I chirp twice.
I squint and doze a little.
I stand on the brim of your hat.

lines.zh: 我用爪子抓了抓你的衣服。
lines.en: I grip your clothes with my claws.

lines.zh: 风吹得我羽毛都竖起来。
lines.en: The wind lifts all my feathers.
I look up at the fruit in the tree.
I chirp quietly.
I am waiting for you to move.

lines.zh: 我的爪子很细，抓得很稳。
lines.en: My claws are thin and grip well.
I hop onto the back of your hand.
I tuck my head into my feathers.
The down on my wings is still soft.
I squat down, like a ball of fluff.
Will you take me to fight it?
I follow you, so I obey you.

lines.zh: 你指向哪里，我就飞哪里。
lines.en: Point anywhere and I will fly there.
I am small, but I am not afraid.
Look — my claws are sharp.
I came out of a summoning circle.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，只要跟着你。
lines.en: I need no food; I only need to follow.
Do not close your hand suddenly.
When tired, I land on your shoulder.
Have you marked that thing as a target?
I will come at it from above.

lines.zh: 你走慢一点，我翅膀还小。
lines.en: Walk slower; my wings are still small.

lines.zh: 我们一起，我打不过就叫你。
lines.en: Together — if I cannot manage, I will call you.
My master watches you. So do I.
A few feathers gone, a little cold.
I let out a sharp chirp.
I drop to the ground, askew.
I beat my wings and cannot rise.
My wing took a blow.
Where my master points, I dive.
I run to your feet.
I have no strength left to call.
Blood shows clearly on my feathers.
I can still fly a short way.
Two pecks — a grain.
I fly over and land on your hand.
I peck at it; it is not a bug.
Leave a little for me.
I hold it in my beak and cannot quite swallow.
This is bigger than a seed.
Three pecks, all husks.
My grip is too small for it.
Let go, and I'll take it.
This much food will last the flight.

lines.zh: 被召出来的雀，只认一个主人。
lines.en: A summoned finch knows only one master.
I flapped to steady myself.
My feathers got rumpled.
I fell to the ground and flew back.

lines.zh: 雀宝宝这么小，也挨得住。
lines.en: A finch chick this small can take a bump.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到我的喙了。
lines.en: Your fingers brushed my beak.

lines.zh: 我跟着主人，也咬他的敌人。
lines.en: I follow my master and bite his enemies.

lines.zh: 我们两个都退了一步，羽毛都炸开了。
lines.en: We both stepped back, feathers fluffed.
Where my master points, I peck.
I chirp and hop aside.
I land on your shoulder and we watch together.
I remember the way you pointed.
We work smoothly together.
You take the front; I go for the eyes.
I will fly a circle and draw it off.

lines.zh: 你受伤了，我就落到你手边。
lines.en: If you are hurt, I will land at your hand.
You need not carry me; I will fly alongside.
We never go far apart.
Sleep; I am close by.
We go together again tomorrow.
It's heavier than me; I fly dangling.
I grip it with my claws; it slips.

lines.zh: 我叼着飞了一段就掉了。
lines.en: I carried it a short way and dropped it.
I drop it at your feet.
This is shiny. I like it.
I hide it under my wing.
Claws cannot hold it; I use my beak.
I bring it to you. Do not mind that it is small.
This is nothing like a bug.
I dropped it and cannot find it.
You marked it, so I go in.
Something moved, over there.
Whoever my master points at, I face.
It is too big; I must pick my spot.
I will test its shell first.

lines.zh: 我个子小，它不容易打到。
lines.en: I am small; it will have trouble hitting me.
I dive down.
Your target — I will keep it busy.
I fly lower to draw it over.
It has not spotted me.
I go in from the left.
When it raises an arm, I strike.
My wings are already spread.
This time I will not call out; I go straight in.
I circle above its head.
It raises a hand and I climb.

lines.zh: 我啾了一声，压低了身子。
lines.en: I chirp once and lower myself.
Each time it turns its head, I switch sides.
My shadow falls at its feet.
When it turns, I beat my wings.
Its movements are a little slow.
A little lower and I can peck it.
It is getting annoyed. Good.
You press it from the front.
I fly fast; it cannot reach me.
This peck must land true.
It turned. I will go behind.
I wait for your word.
Now — I go.
I peck at its eye.
My claws rake once.
I dive and strike its back.
It swipes; I fly clear.
I come back for a second peck.
That only hit hard hide.

lines.zh: 我啄了一下，又赶紧飞开。
lines.en: I peck once, then flit away.
I land on your shoulder, panting.
It fell back, and I did too.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，再啄一口。
lines.en: I circle behind it and peck again.

lines.zh: 我从光里出来，落在你手边。
lines.en: I come out of the light and land by your hand.

lines.zh: 我是被召出来的小家伙。
lines.en: I am a little thing that was summoned.
First I test my wings.

lines.zh: 你手心里就是我的位置。
lines.en: Your palm is where I belong.
I called once the moment I appeared.

lines.zh: 主人一招手，我就落下来。
lines.en: My master beckons, and I land.
I land on the ground and bounce twice.
I look up to find you.
My feathers are still soft.

lines.zh: 我拍着小翅膀，落在你肩上。
lines.en: I beat my small wings and land on your shoulder.
The wind makes me unsteady.
There are two of us now.
I stand at your feet, waiting for you to move.
This time, I follow you.
My feathers are singed.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，我的翅膀歪了。
lines.en: When I hit the ground, my wing bent.
Water soaks my feathers and I sink.

lines.zh: 被召唤出来的小鸟，也会被炸飞。
lines.en: Even a summoned bird can be blasted away.

lines.zh: 有东西擦过了我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something grazed my wing.

lines.zh: 一股力量扯着我的骨头。
lines.en: A force pulls at my bones.
I am too hungry to fly.
The thunder is so loud that I tremble.
I fall with nowhere to land.
